title: AnthropicIPO超额认购 估值或达1.3万亿
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's stay there. The Anthropic IPO Roadshow underway.
segments.zh: 我们继续关注。Anthropic的IPO路演正在进行。

segments.en: Source is telling us here at Bloomberg, the offering is multiple times over subscribed with public trading expected to begin next week.
segments.zh: 彭博消息源称，此次发行已获多倍超额认购，公开交易预计下周开始。

segments.en: David Rubenstein of the Carlyle Group, I am so pleased to say joins us now for more.
segments.zh: 凯雷集团的David Rubenstein很高兴加入我们，带来更多分析。

segments.en: David, so good to see you. Thank you for being with us. I want to start with the capital market cycle with the Anthropic IPO, likely to price next week.
segments.zh: David，很高兴见到你。感谢参与。我想从资本市场周期谈起，Anthropic的IPO可能下周定价。

segments.en: Where do you see us in this capital market cycle right now?
segments.zh: 您认为我们目前处于资本市场周期的哪个阶段？

segments.en: Well, clearly, the IPO is going to get done and get done at a very, very high valuation.
segments.zh: 显然，这次IPO将会完成，而且估值非常非常高。

segments.en: I think only probably the deal that was higher was the SpaceX valuation.
segments.zh: 我认为可能只有SpaceX的估值更高。

segments.en: The Anthropic deal was originally going to go at something like closer to $2 trillion.
segments.zh: Anthropic的交易最初定价接近2万亿美元。

segments.en: I think because a lot of other things going on in the market, it's more likely to go to about 1.3 trillion.
segments.zh: 我认为由于市场其他因素，更可能降至约1.3万亿美元。

segments.en: But that's still a very, very high valuation.
segments.zh: 但这仍然是极高的估值。

segments.en: And it's a company that doesn't earn any money, but still has great potential.
segments.zh: 这家公司目前没有盈利，但潜力巨大。

segments.en: So it'll be massively oversubscribed, but people should remember that when people want to buy stock and something hot like this, they ask for more than they expect to get.
segments.zh: 因此会出现大幅超额认购，但人们应记住，当大家想买入这样热门的权益资产时，申购数量会超过预期获配量。

segments.en: So when something is double triple or quadruple oversubscribed, it's not because people really expect to get four times or three times what they ask where they expect to get a fraction
segments.zh: 所以当某样东西获得两倍、三倍或四倍超额认购时，并不是因为人们真的预期能拿到申购量的四倍或三倍，而是预期只获配一小部分。

segments.en: of it, and that's why it's often massively oversubscribed.
segments.zh: 这就是它常常出现大幅超额认购的原因。
